text.offer: There is something worse than kriipa under this island: the shadowbeasts, kin of the kriipa, that haunt the archaic hollows and the aqueducts in the orc caves. I have never fought one and lived to say I won. Kill six, and you are the greatest warrior Ko'catan has known.
text.progress: The shadowbeasts haunt the Archaic Hollows and the Aqueducts of Merb, in the orc caves below the island.
text.complete: Six shadowbeasts. I bow to you - and I do not bow.
